buscar: Search by MAC, account or door

vacio.texto: Register a board with its MAC to link it to a door.

registrarAyuda: The MAC shows up when you power the board on, over the serial port (status command).
macInvalida: Enter a valid MAC: six pairs of hexadecimal digits.
codigoInstruccion: Load it onto the board over the serial port with this command:
codigoAviso: This code is not shown again. If you lose it, remove the board and register it again.
vincularTitulo: Link the board to a door
vincularTexto: Board {{mac}} will be assigned to the account and door you choose.
puertaPlaceholder: Choose a door without a reader
sinPuertasLibres: This account has no doors without a reader.
liberarTexto: The door is left without a reader and the board stops opening it. You can then link it to another account.
bajaTexto: It leaves the inventory. Use this if the board was lost or damaged.
